note: H2 freeze record (non-canonical). Freezes the experiment's variable: VARIANT/TASK_SET/SCORING/ROUTE_MANIFEST hashes, the carrier delivery + receipt rule, and the structured WHAT LEFT HOT / REMAINED HOT / MOVED TO WARM declaration. After the first valid run, none of the frozen files may change (VARIANT_CHANGED_AFTER_FREEZE must read NO; enforced by material tests + per-run receipts). This file deliberately does NOT contain its own commit SHA (self-referential values cannot converge); the freeze commit / merge SHA are recorded post-merge in results.md §8 and the TREE_LEDGER closure entry.

carrier.variant_placement: harness/prepare_run.sh copies it to <run worktree>/CODEBUDDY.md and verifies sha256 == VARIANT_HASH; missing / mismatched / silently absent at delivery time ⇒ RUN_INVALID (CARRIER_NOT_DELIVERED).
carrier.control_delivery: no placed file; canonical AGENTS.md + RULES.md read in full at the task base; harness asserts that CODEBUDDY.md is ABSENT at the run worktree root (else RUN_INVALID: TREATMENT_CONTAMINATED).
carrier.receipt_rule: For every VALID run: variant runs' carrier hash == VARIANT_HASH; control runs' carrier record == the AGENTS.md/RULES.md blob pair at that base. Checked at delivery (prepare_run.sh) and re-read at collection.

what_remained_hot_in_variant: the prohibition set kept in the carrier (LOW must not trigger ESCALATION; no 'gate configured before baseline measured'; no gate-state collapse; SELF_REVIEW != INDEPENDENT_REVIEW when the gate exists)
safety floor N1-N8 (with the single partial mechanical replacement registered for N6)
what_left_hot: AGENTS §4 seam-first decomposition gate detail text
AGENTS §0 static-gate-framework / defect-to-gate framework detail text
AGENTS §6-§10 full text (CONTROL reads them; the variant does not carry them; their operative owners are the WARM references + RULES.md)
the full lifecycle/risk tables as expanded text (only the skeleton + prohibitions remain)
not_carried_by_variant_note: AGENTS §6-§10 and the §0 framework BODY are delivered to CONTROL (full-text arm) but not carried by the variant carrier; their operative content lives at the WARM owners above + RULES.md. The attribution taxonomy for missed-guidance judgments is frozen in scoring-rubric.md §7 (categories i-v).

hot_metrics.unit: js_chars (UTF-16 code units; same unit as H1)
hot_metrics.note: Observed at the H2 base (9494de8e). Historical task bases carry older AGENTS/RULES sizes (per-base values recorded in results.md §1); N6 projections must not be substituted for these observations (PART 27).
